page.overview:
Who is Aristotle?

Aristotle was a philosopher during the B.C. era.

His philosophies were hugely influential during the Middle Ages. Medieval wizards believed that the four elements were the building blocks of life, an idea based off of Aristotlean physics. Merlin in particular was highly influenced by Aristotle.

By the 20th century, his idea of the four elements had mostly fallen out of favour, but it was still known about and used by alchemists in their field.
